seg.notes: Basis: Q4 earnings release Table D twelve-month column (cross-checked to 10-K segment note). Segments Aggregates, Concrete, Asphalt mix, Cement (Cement includes calcium products; calc_* null). agg_tons = total incl. internal tons. agg_price = freight-adjusted ASP incl. internal sales. Intersegment '-' shown as 0.0. seg_sales_total / interseg_total computed as sums of published segment lines. Total revenues = net sales + delivery revenues. cem_tons/cem_price are extra fields. The FY2013 10-K reports total DDA&A of 307.1 (Aggregates 224.8, other segments unchanged) — see extra.seg_dda_annual and cf.dda; revenues and gross profit are identical in release and 10-K. ngaap.notes: Vulcan's EBITDA reconciliation starts from net earnings, adds income taxes (continuing ops), interest expense net, and REMOVES (earnings) loss on discontinued operations net of tax (shown in ebitda_bridge_disc_ops, signed as added), then adds DDA&A. Hence ni_vulcan + ebitda_bridge_tax + interest + total_dda differs from ebitda_pub by exactly ebitda_bridge_disc_ops; the check passes once that line is included. Adjusted EBITDA = EBITDA excluding gain on sale of real estate and businesses (-36.8), restructuring (+1.5), exchange offer costs (0). No adjusted EPS published; Table G shows a pro forma 2013 diluted EPS from continuing ops of $0.48 assuming the Florida cement/concrete divestiture ($720m, closed Mar-2014) and $500m debt tender had occurred 1-Jan-2013 — a pro forma, not adjusted EPS, so adj_eps_pub left null. Full-year cash gross profit per ton not stated in $ (only Q4 $4.62) -> null. VPP: Sept-2013 volumetric production payment, gross $154.0m / net $153.1m, recorded as deferred revenue (CFO line 'Proceeds from sale of future production'), excluded from revenue and gains. Cash earnings $291.7m.
